policy_validity.effective_date_basis: The official pages did not state a policy start date; this snapshot is supported only from the observed-active date and must not be back-cast.

sources.title: Nature Portfolio Artificial Intelligence (AI) Editorial Policy

acceptance_objective.rule: An Article must report original research, be of outstanding scientific importance, and reach a conclusion of interest to an interdisciplinary readership; editorial triage additionally seeks novel, arresting results with immediate and far-reaching implications.

scientific_gates.rule: The Article reports original scientific research.
Main results and conclusions have not been published or submitted elsewhere.
Technical failings identified in review must be addressed before the authors' case is established.
The manuscript is readable enough for editors and nonspecialist readers to understand the work and its field-level consequence.

novelty_gate.rule: At editorial triage, results should seem novel and arresting (illuminating, unexpected, or surprising).

impact_gate.rule: The work must be of outstanding scientific importance and have immediate and far-reaching implications under the exact Article criteria.

breadth_gate.rule: The conclusion must matter beyond the immediate specialty and be appropriate for an interdisciplinary readership.

audience_interest_gate.rule: Nature editors judge whether the work is likely to interest readers outside its immediate field.

burden_of_doubt.rule: No reviewed exact rule instructs editors or referees to resolve uncertainty in favor of satisfying novelty, importance, breadth, or audience interest.

allowed_repair_routes.constraint: The revision must establish the scientific case rather than merely rebut the report.
Clarification may expose real breadth; it cannot manufacture importance or implications.
Narrowing is scientifically valid when evidence requires it, but the narrowed paper may then fail Nature's independent importance, implication, or breadth gates.
Appeals must address a specific serious error in the decision process or technical assessment; they are not a general second review path.

review_model.triage: A subject editor makes the initial send-for-review decision, consulting scientific advisers and editorial colleagues; most submissions are declined without review.
review_model.reviewers: Most reviewed papers go to two or three independent referees, with occasional variation.
review_model.vote_rule: Editors weigh technical arguments and expertise; referee editorial opinions do not mechanically decide Nature fit.
review_model.revision_model: Technical failings must be addressed, while the editor retains responsibility for journal-level readership and priority judgements.

ai_confidentiality_policy.author_ai_use: Assistive uses may be permitted by risk level, but human accountability is non-transferable; evaluative or interpretive use requires oversight, verification, and transparent disclosure, and AI cannot be an author.
ai_confidentiality_policy.reviewer_ai_use: Reviewers remain responsible for independent expert evaluation, must not delegate critique or judgement to AI, and should disclose AI use.
ai_confidentiality_policy.confidentiality: Manuscripts, peer-review reports, and sensitive data must not be shared with unsecured or public AI systems.

certification_layer.notes: No article-level certification scheme separate from Nature acceptance was identified in the reviewed exact sources. Repository contract/source certification must never be described as a Nature award or decision.
